threads.body: [Naming] This exception is intentionally unused, so the repository catch-parameter convention requires `ignored`; the longer type-derived name obscures that the catch is only the compatibility fallback. The same reflective fallback pattern uses `ignored` in `instrumentation/logback/logback-appender-1.0/library/src/test/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/logback/appender/v1_0/Helper.java:28`.
